notes.title: version 2.0.2
notes.notes:
A small update
- Bug fixed: some achievements don't work
- add a new achievement: Short jump.
- Bug fixed: some maps don't have property start values
- Car a bit more slowed

notes.title: - NEW CAR PHYSICS - Update 2.0.0
notes.notes:
[h1]Car physics[/h1]
Completely new physics and the behavior of the car

[url=https://youtu.be/quz2ePrbT84]Trailer[/url]

[h1]A new way to win stars[/h1]
Now you get points for picking pumpkins and other actions such as flying or drifting.
Hit the car or respawn makes you lose points.

Pumpkins not collected left behind become violet and can not be picked.
Bonus points for fast arrival to the finish line.

[h1]Others changes[/h1]
Remove some objects from the sides of the roads to make it easier
Icons are no longer pixelated
Presets buttons of video settings.
Light improvements in the scenarios

[h1][b]Races[/b][/h1][list][*]Improved fog and placement of pumpkins on some maps.[/*][/list]
 
[h1][b]Bugs[/b][/h1][list][*]Now the horn does not echo if you repeatedly hit.[/*][/list]

notes.title: UPDATE 1.1.0 is alive!!
notes.notes:
[h1] [/h1]
[b]Improved control of the car[/b]
[list][*]Now is very difficult, almost impossible, to overturn in sharp curves.[/*][*]I also improved the control of the car while skidding and turning curves.[/*][*]Increased peak speed, and increased braking power and handbrake.[/*][*]When you overturn now they will get up faster.

[/*][/list]
[b]9 new races[/b]
[list][*]This version comes with 9 new races, now the game there are altogether 18 races.[list][*]I used the maps already created with the layout in opposite direction with small changes where there were jumps.

[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]Best light in the scenes[/b]
[list][*]I have reviewed the scenes so they are not so dark and the car looks better and illuminated.

[/*][/list]
[b]Bugs[/b]
[list][*]It seems that if you were to continue on the last map exploded everything :S. Fixed.

[/*][/list]
